sources.coordinate_reference: The layer metadata's native spatial reference is EPSG:3857 (WKID 102100/latestWKID 3857). The saved GeoJSON query response is EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude.
sources.measurement_method: Use FID 915, BLDG_ABBR LSR, Life Science Ranges, 180 S Russell Street. Convert its Polygon rings to the project XY system; use the envelope midpoint as the proposed collection origin. Preserve outer and inner rings.

fields_relevant_to_height.interpretation: The layer schema exposes Extrution as an editable nullable integer with no units, field description, domain, or definition. The value 12 is recorded but cannot be verified as meters, feet, a height, or an extrusion instruction. NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO are counts, not vertical dimensions. Elevation is also not used as building height because its vertical datum/units are not documented in this layer response. None of these values are treated as a measured building height.

sources.uncertainty: No survey accuracy or feature-specific vertical units are published in the saved layer metadata. The GIS geometry is authoritative for horizontal envelope only; the approximate project conversion is not survey-grade.

height_decision.status: All model vertical dimensions are estimates. The GIS field Extrution=12 is an integer of undocumented meaning/units and is explicitly not treated as measured height. No dimensioned as-built section or elevation was found in the reviewed sources.
